verdict: Lead cost rose sharply this week; efficiency fix is already underway.
narrative: You received 116 leads over the last 28 days at an average cost of $11.65 per lead, but the most recent 7 days showed cost per lead spike 47% as spend climbed while lead volume dipped slightly — a clear sign the primary campaign is reaching a less responsive audience. Your Google Business Profile engagement also fell sharply this week, which reduces the organic activity that normally supports paid performance. We're addressing the paid campaign concentration and audience fatigue directly, and a GBP recovery push is in motion alongside it. Separately, leads are entering your pipeline but none are converting to booked appointments, which is a follow-up and intake issue we're working through with you — not an ads problem. Expect tighter cost-per-lead numbers as these adjustments take hold over the next two weeks.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead has deteriorated over the past 7 days as the top campaign scales into a narrowing audience, with zero booked appointments despite 116 leads entering the pipeline.
watch_item.fix: We're rebalancing campaign spend away from the saturated audience and working with your team to close the gap between leads received and appointments booked.
